fields.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL (the part before /chat/completions).
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Stored encrypted. Not needed for a local Ollama server.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Model id, e.g. gpt-4o-mini, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, qwen2.5:14b.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Ask the model for JSON output (response_format). It is dropped automatically if the model rejects it.
fields.label: JSON Mode

fields.description: Send the aggregated result (totals and at most 20 groups, no documents) to the model for a one or two sentence comment. Off: only the question and the metric list leave the server.
fields.label: Comment on Results

fields.description: Answer as if today were this date, for test sites with old data. Empty: today.
fields.label: Reference Date

fields.description: Metric keys to hide from the assistant, one per line.
fields.label: Disabled Metrics
